decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording C5149201, SK6812MINI-E, OPSCO, the 3228 package, and RGBW format while removing the obsolete selected_led_part key.
Selecting a specific SK6812MINI-E part does not change the charge-status display method, GPIO, or dedicated charge-LED interface.
The selected LED package and part number do not change the standalone USB regulator, its powered 3.3V rail, or source-selection behavior.
The LED component selection does not alter any interboard power connector, signal connector, pinout, or board power-chain requirement.
The boost rail continues to power SK6812 addressable LEDs at 5V; choosing the exact SK6812MINI-E package does not change its loads, enable control, or standby policy.
The LED part selection has no effect on USB enumeration, programming, data routing, or connector sourcing.
The source selects an LED component and does not change the SPS30 connector, supply, I2C signals, or mode-selection wiring.
The selected LED part is unrelated to the sensor-board input and external-module connector fanout.
The LED manufacturer and package selection do not resolve or change the battery connector family, part number, or pin order.
The source changes only the selected LED part; it does not alter DCDC1 voltage, current rating, stability, or normal-operation load coverage.
This candidate concerns power-board BOM readiness, while the source selects the addressable LED used by the LED interface and daughterboard; no power-board BOM attribute is necessarily changed.
Selecting the exact LED component does not change the AXP2101 battery input, normal-operation source, or system power-path coverage.
